protocols.title: Daily foundation
protocols.tagline: A few simple, evidence-first basics for most healthy adults.
protocols.for: Healthy adults who want a simple, evidence-first daily routine.

protocols.title: Desk worker day
protocols.tagline: Short, regular movement breaks for long days at a desk.
protocols.for: Office and remote staff who sit for long periods at work.

protocols.title: Iron top-up (low iron confirmed)
protocols.tagline: Every-other-day iron, timed well, with planned blood tests.
protocols.for: Adults whose blood test shows low iron (low ferritin) and whose doctor has advised iron tablets.

protocols.title: Blood sugar support
protocols.tagline: Daily habits that help keep blood sugar steadier, alongside your care.
protocols.for: Adults with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes, working with their doctor or diabetes team.

protocols.title: Vein health
protocols.tagline: Calf-pump moves, leg rest and stockings, with doctor-guided vein supplements.
protocols.for: Adults with varicose veins or chronic venous insufficiency, alongside their doctor's care.

protocols.title: Surgery prep and recovery
protocols.tagline: Simple steps before and after a planned operation, led by your surgical team.
protocols.for: Adults with a planned (non-emergency) operation. Day 0 is the day of surgery: negative days are before, positive days after.

protocols.title: Gut and microbiome
protocols.tagline: More fibre, fermented foods and plant variety, built up slowly.
protocols.for: Adults who want to support gut health through food and daily habits.

protocols.title: Fascia and tissue support
protocols.tagline: Load your tissues well, eat enough protein, and time collagen before sessions.
protocols.for: Active adults doing regular strength or movement sessions who want to support tendons and connective tissue.

protocols.title: Plant-based essentials
protocols.tagline: The key nutrients to cover when you eat vegan or vegetarian.
protocols.for: Adults who eat a vegan or vegetarian diet.
